title: Laos
summary: Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Southeast Asia.

paragraphs: Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Southeast Asia.

Laos is the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Myanmar and by China to the northwest, by Vietnam to the east, by Cambodia to the south and by Thailand to the west. The Mekong river forms a part of the western boundary with Thailand. Boats from Laos cannot get to the ocean using the Mekong because of rapids and waterfalls in the south of the country.[5] Laos is the least densely populated country in Southeast Asia, with 32 people per square kilometer.[6] A railway connection between Thailand and Laos has been operational since July 2024, with trains running to Khamsavath railway station in Vientiane prefecture.[7]

sections.heading: History
paragraphs: Laos became a French colony in 1893 and became part of French Indochina. In 1949 it became independent from France, as the Kingdom of Laos. The Laotian Civil War started in May 1959. In 1975 Laos became a one-party state under the leadership of the communist party.

On 20 July 1954 an agreement was signed - Agreement on the Cessation of Hostilities in Laos. That agreement ended France's rule of Laos. 2 months later, the authorities of North Vietnam, established a support group for Pathet Lao, in Ban Nameo.
From the middle of the 1960s, Laos was used by North Vietnam as a route to attack South Vietnam. U.S. forces dropped bombs on Laos, to try to stop the supplies carried along the Ho Chi Minh Trail.
South Vietnam was taken (or fell) in April 1975. On 14 May 1975 Vang Pao escaped from Laos, thru the military base at Long Tieng.
